summary: Revised implementation plan adding a dedicated black tint/scrim layer over the blurred background on the Lyrics page so white lyrics stay crisp and readable even when the album art has bright or white colors, alongside zero-lag song list scrolling, restored Lyrics background settings, true pitch-black & white Monochrome mode with per-theme customizers, persistent embedded lyrics cache with Clear buttons, LRC/Plain-Text support with strict same-song matching, and smooth line/word animations.
